$comment: JOV-13089 - App Store Connect minimum-SDK requirement table (ITMS-90725). One row per Apple requirement. Dates come from Apple's own pages, never invented. When Apple announces a new minimum, add ONE row with its source URL.

rows.sourceQuote: Since April 28, 2026 - Apps uploaded to App Store Connect must be built with Xcode 26 or later using an SDK for iOS 26, iPadOS 26, tvOS 26, visionOS 26, or watchOS 26.

rows.effectiveDateNote: Apple announced 'Starting April 2027' (month only) on 2026-09-09; no day published. First of the announced month used as the conservative effective date.
rows.sourceQuote: Starting April 2027, apps and games uploaded to App Store Connect need to meet the following minimum requirements. iOS and iPadOS apps must be built with the iOS & iPadOS 27 SDK or later.
